scope: Proposition 4.3 (Link identities) of the manuscript “Arithmeticity of twisted finite correspondences for lattices over local fields” (preprints/Arithmeticity-of-twisted-finite-correspondences-for-lattices-over-local-fields-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 286 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 b1d070a5c4cd8496), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 23. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: The one-column measurements and the forms (4.1) have the following properties. (i) The image measurement in one measured copy lies in Aj, is βj-equivariant, and is invariant under the source face parabolic. Its gap-stratum masses belong to N and are scalar. Conjugating the source split frame transports the measurement by σ. (ii) If the path escapes in every simple component, the link is an isometry H ⊗ H → K. Its output forms are decomposable at the two bases, covariant under the two independent target shifts, invariant under the independently contracted source radicals, and invariant under simultaneous source centralizers. An image-and-stratum effect depends only on the start input and is 1 ⊗ Φ(A); the reverse rule is symmetric. (iii) If the path is active precisely in a subproduct G0, put N0 = NG0 , and let EN0 : N → N0 be the trace-preserving conditional expectation. On bounded columns the link instead has the form (4.2) ∥J(b, f)∥2 = d2 τN EN0 (ff∗ )EN0 (bb∗ )  . Its polarized extension on finite sums is a positive semidefinite form. The same Gram covariances hold on this form space; they do not assert a tensor-product isometry. The precise Hilbert-input extensions are given in Lemma 4.4. (iv) For any Borel event A determined by a gap stratum and its image flag, the finite-frame identity is (4.3) ⟨f, Φ(A)f⟩ = 1 d k X r=1 ∥E(A)J(br, f)∥2 . It holds on mixed and nonmixed paths. More generally it holds for events in additional limiting coordinates which are unchanged by the ignored left Fourier shifts. When a proof starts with windows that also constrain the reverse flag or residual projectivity, those windows must first be exhausted to such an invariant event. (v) The image measurements are independent of the finite regular embedding. Adding another original tensor slot gives their normal copies, tensored with the identity on that slot. This assertion concerns these compressed measurements and operators determined by their stated one-ended covariance and uniqueness. All statements use the specified order of successive limits. A contracted translate must tend to the identity in that order.
